g.text: KDLock mutex throughput and TCLock target
Native acquisition before pin + published shadow reads
Peak = highest valid 300 ms window after 300 ms settling; 2 s measured, 48,000 warmup ops/worker; 3 rounds.
Upper panels: median and min–max. Lower panels: best KD / best TCLock within each complete three-round phase; dashed line = 90%.
NO_JIT and other failed samples are excluded, preserved in metadata, and never connected into target curves. Separate recheck is not pooled.
Pinned workers; fixed 2.5 GHz; NUMA enabled; private KD provider UBSAN off. Throughput does not establish equal per-worker service.
